entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Our master wishes to speak with you![n]Heed his words!

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: You've defeated the repulsive fiend of[n]gluttony this time. *chuckle* Well done.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: I am glad to see you have devoted[n]yourself to your rehabilitation.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: You are not worthy of such kind words,[n]Inmate... I suggest you treasure them.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Do you recall the whispers about that[n]strange man?

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: You forgot already!? This fool is beyond[n]redemption!

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Even a chicken could remember[n]something that important! Don't[n]sound so cocky about it!

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: ...This is about the cases of those people[n]who shut down, is it not?

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Indeed... I speak of another with powers[n]similar to yours.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: If you are to complete your rehabilitation,[n]you may encounter him eventually...

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: *chuckle* Yet another thing for me to[n]look forward to.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: It would be greatly troubling if you were[n]to not strengthen your abilities.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: I shall grant you an ability befitting of[n]your newfound growth. Consider it a gift.
I feel like my bond with Igor[n]is growing deeper...
